messages:
oliver: Ran into a weird onboarding glitch: if you close the sampleapp mid-stream we sometimes surface half-JSON objects in the UI. Repro steps below.
maya: Oof. Which sampleapps / SDKs?
oliver: JS + Python both. Happens when you interrupt (ctrl+c / close tab) shortly after tokens start.
frank: Can you paste logs/snippet?
oliver: Sure. Minimal trace: 
```
[info] open stream /v1/response
[debug] recv: data: {\"part\":\" Hel\"
[debug] client SIGINT
[debug] flush rem: \"lo\"
[error] parser: emitted partial event
```
oliver: UI ends up with something like {"part":" Hel"} and then a trailing fragment that breaks JSON.parse.
maya: That sounds like parser.finalize() is emitting leftover buffer without confirming SSE delimiter. Could be worse when auth refresh/replay runs concurrently.
frank: Right. If auth refresh triggers a reconnect we may replay the tail chunk and get duplicates or interleaved halves.
oliver: Impact is mostly demos and new-hire sessions but it's noisy.
maya: Proposed short-term: sampleapps should swallow final incomplete events and show "partial output omitted". Parser tweak: on finalize only emit if buffer contains a full SSE event (endsWith('\n\n') or matches complete `data:` block). Long-term: document shutdown semantics for SDKs so they behave consistently (flush vs drop).
frank: Tests: add unit tests for mid-chunk SIGINT and integration test simulating auth refresh during stream + client abort. I'll add both.
ci-bot: created task #7890: "streaming: avoid emitting partial SSE events on client shutdown; add sampleapp mitigations".
qa-bot: NOTE: please include a tiny repro script for docs so TEs can replicate.
oliver: Will open two small PRs: parser+tests and JS/Python sampleapp graceful-shutdown. Will include repro script and tag @maya for review.
maya: Thanks 44d. Also add a one-liner to devex onboarding: "avoid abrupt client kills during live demos; use graceful stop helper".
